hotels.title: King Island Award-Winning Cape Wickham Golf Retreat with Daily Breakfast & Two-Day Green Fees Included
hotels.description: Tee off at the edge of the world on an award-winning championship links course, where the rugged King Island coastline frames every fairway with jaw-dropping beauty. Consistently ranked among the best courses on the planet and named Australia's top-ranked course by Golf Digest, Cape Wickham is a masterpiece of design with coastal winds that will keep you on your toes. With green fees included for two days of unlimited golf, you’ll have boundless time to tackle the exclusive fairways that make this course so legendary. Enjoy a cooked breakfast each morning at Cape Wickham Clubhouse to fuel days on the green. Make the most of your time on the coast with an early morning swim at Victoria Cove, or sharpen up for rounds ahead on the 12-hole putting course. After you've hit your last putt, put your feet up in a villa-like room with expansive ocean vistas that make it impossible to miss a shot at relaxation.
